title: Just Math Mathalli
desc: In a desperate attempt to reconcile with Tanu, the girl he had previously rejected, popular singer Siddharth flies to Singapore. On the flight, he meets Adi, a scriptwriter, and shares his love story.

title: Love Mocktail
desc: After rescuing a woman, a man reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

title: Chellata
desc: In order to secure money for his sister's dowry, Ganesh invests his money in a business, only to lose it. During this process, a rich woman falls in love with him, unaware of his financial condition.

title: Trivikrama
desc: Vikram, a young man, believes in fairness attained through any means necessary. Later, his past haunts him as he falls in love with Trisha, a wide-eyed girl.

title: Jeevana Chaitra
desc: A man discovers that alcohol is a major problem in the villages. Men buy alcohol with the minimal money they have and do not work, while the wives and children get neglected and abused.
